title: Make native OpenAI and Codex search production-correct
description: Audit current Responses web_search request and SSE/source normalization against current official behavior. Add deterministic fixtures for current response variants, verify live OpenAI/Codex paths once with credential-gated smoke coverage, preserve domain filters, usage, cancellation, and no hidden fallback.

logs.msg: Parent plan: native-first correctness is P0; output and Exa routing are coordinated tasks. Preserve one provider per call and no fallback after provider failure.

Audited current OpenAI/Codex Responses adapter against official Responses web_search shape and prior extension; existing strict parser, SSE completion checks, citation/source normalization, auth selection, cancellation, and diagnostics remain covered by tests.
